jobs.title: Retail Security Officer Customer-First Guard & Growth
jobs.description:
Marksman in Friendswood, Texas, is seeking security personnel to provide excellent customer service and ensure a safe environment.

Responsibilities include monitoring security systems, controlling access, and maintaining logs. Ideal candidates must possess a high school diploma or GED and a valid level 2 license.

Benefits include starting pay of $15.81/hour, paid time off, and opportunities for career growth and training. The role requires availability for evening, overnight, and weekend shifts.

jobs.title: Retail Security Officer: Customer Service & Patrol Specialist
jobs.description: Marksman Security LLC in Friendswood, Texas is seeking dedicated security personnel. Candidates must have a high school diploma or GED, be at least 18 years old, and possess a valid level 2 security license. Responsibilities include providing excellent customer service, monitoring security cameras, conducting patrols, and responding to emergencies. The position starts at $15.81/hour, with paid time off, medical, and dental benefits, plus opportunities for career growth and training.

jobs.title: Armed Security Specialist - Veteran Preferred, Daily Pay
jobs.description: Cascadia Global Security is hiring Armed Security personnel in Friendswood, TX. This full-time position requires retired law enforcement or military experience, with a focus on customer service in a high-end retail environment. The pay is $20 per hour, and benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage after 60 days. Candidates must be 21 or older and able to pass a background check. Rising from the ranks is encouraged through advancement opportunities.
